title: Fine Arts Performance Trip Travel Fee — Business Office Computation, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees 2026-27
content:
**Performance trip travel fee.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the travel fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is the scheduled ensemble travel fee: the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble travel fee of the activity fee catalogue, rounded to the cent. A travel fee that works out to 0.00 posts nothing.

**Trips.** The ensemble's performance trips for the 2026-27 school year:

| Ensemble | Performance trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| band and orchestra | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-02-26, 2027-04-30 |
| any other ensemble (choir, theatre) | 2026-11-06, 2027-01-29, 2027-03-26, 2027-05-07 |

**Order.** The travel fee is assembled in this order: amounts are added together first, the shares are then applied one after the other to that total, never below 0.00, any further amounts are added after the shares, and the result is rounded once, at the end, to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** Amounts of 130.00 and minus 15.00 total 115.00. A share of 90 percent gives 103.50; a share of 70 percent of that gives 72.45. Further amounts of 6.00 and 4.00 added after the shares give 82.45, which is the fee to the cent.

- The further amounts are never multiplied by a share.
- The cent is fixed once, on the final figure.
- A total of amounts below 0.00 counts as 0.00 before the shares act.
